descriptions.text: The Smart Bank Token (SBT) contract on BNBChain was attacked, resulting in a loss of approximately $56,000.

Smart Bank Token on BNB Chain was drained within five minutes of deployment on July 11, 2024 through a flash loan exploit that manipulated its internal collateral price calculation. The attacker borrowed nearly $2 million USDT using inflated SBT collateral and retained approximately $56,000 from the protocol. The contract determined the collateral price using its own spot USDT/SBT balance, allowing an attacker to manipulate both balances in a single transaction with a flash loan. This self-referential pricing failed to resist instant atomic manipulation.
